claimChecks.claim: Höckel makes TFL universally first-choice for any inguinal vulvar defect
claimChecks.note: Described as a proposal for selected defects, not universal guidance.

claimChecks.claim: Gandolfi found SCIA supply in six of seven and IGA in three of seven cases, proving safe TFL harvest after LCFA injury
claimChecks.note: Six SCIA and three IGA arteries were injection counts, not success denominators; post-injury harvest was a hypothesis with one case.

claimChecks.claim: TFL harvest causes at most 15% hip-abduction loss
claimChecks.note: Force result was positional induced weakness, not donor-site postoperative outcome.

claimChecks.claim: Nirmal proves routine prophylactic TFL superiority and 83% had no necrosis

claimChecks.note: Retrospective 25-patient study; 17/20 (85%) had no reported TFL minor necrosis; 75% versus 17% is ilioinguinal subset.

claimChecks.note: Population averages and cadaveric zone retained with need for patient-specific localization.
